Our kingdom — where we actually are

Already in our V14 preview: the approved illustrated homepage, eight helpers, movable pocket friend, speech bubbles, quiet/voice options, help steps and a separate Grown-Ups' Corner.

Proposed trial and membership: seven days without a card, up to three storybooks; A$14.99 monthly / A$129.99 yearly. Billing and trials are not running here.

Protection: nothing in this standalone page publishes to GitHub or the internet. Demo storybooks save only in this browser if storage is available.

What we are reviewing for V15

The illustrated homepage, eight guides, a dockable helper and the parent entrance come from our recovered V14. The additional rooms on this page are new local demonstrations to help us agree on the next version.

Priorities: child-first workshop, Choose Characters/Places/Magic Pieces/My Own Drawing; personal stories; story-to-scene previews; saved books; narration; and printing/exporting. Drawings and actual AI-generated films are still future implementations.

Safety: no public child accounts, recording, microphone permission management or payment functions operate in this local review.
